title: QFS
subtitle: Test your understanding of QFS — the counterfeit banking rail that captures Free Will through a fake gold-backed payout.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Quantum Financial System is a counterfeit banking rail and a financial Salvation Lure. A redemption signature surrenders Free Will, the Q-phone ties the holder into a 5G tracking grid, and the appointment routes the seeker into custodial containment. The move from 3D to 5D remains an internal consciousness shift. Refusing the signature, the Q-phone, and the redemption gate keeps sovereign authority intact.

options.rationale: The QFS is an entirely fake financial rail and an artificial construct rather than a genuine quantum banking infrastructure.

options.label: C
options.text: A counterfeit banking rail designed to obtain voluntary human consent and capture Free Will.
options.rationale: The QFS is a financial trap designed to obtain voluntary human consent and capture Free Will.

options.label: D
